title: wp-starter-kit build.config.json
description: Project-level build configuration: decouples wp-starter-kit build engine from downstream consumer projects. Validated at the start of loadTargetRegistry(). When absent, the engine falls back to convention-based auto-discovery.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema file.

contentRoot.description: Path to the wp-content directory (absolute or relative to the config file).

activeTheme.description: Active theme directory name under wp-content/themes (e.g. "tavangary"). Replaces hardcoded theme paths.

functionPrefix.description: Reserved function prefix for the AST transformer (e.g. "tavangary_").

pipelineTestModeEnvVar.description: Environment variable name that enables pipeline test mode. Defaults to WPDEV_PIPELINE_TEST_MODE.

dockerContainerName.description: Docker container name used by docker smoke tests. Replaces hardcoded container names.

targets.description: Build targets keyed by consumer slug. A target may be minimal (e.g. {"buildProfile": "s"}) — missing fields are filled by convention.

impactTargets.description: Non-artifact impact-only targets (shared framework source, themes).

buildProfile.description: Build profile. "standalone" keeps namespaces intact; "s" is Profile S obfuscation.

sourceDir.description: Source directory name under wp-content/plugins. Convention: {slug}-dev.

deployDir.description: Deploy directory name under wp-content/plugins. Convention: {slug}.

bootstrapFile.description: Plugin bootstrap file inside the source dir. Convention: {slug}.php.

sharedFramework.description: Shared framework id providing the inlined closure. Convention: detected from composer.json, default "wpdev".

requiredFqcns.description: Fully-qualified class names the completeness gate must verify for this consumer.

sourceDir.description: Source directory name (plugin dir or theme dir).

sourceKind.description: Only for impact-only targets pointing at a theme or plugin.
